boundaries: Handwritten instruction/state/SQL mapping, not extracted async Rust, formal SQL/Serde/driver/compiler refinement.
PostgreSQL transaction atomicity/visibility/constraints, Read Committed post-wait row locking and connection behavior are modeled primitive semantics, not proved native engine code.
Commit applies current staged deltas without completeness/CAS/audit guard; correct program ordering is proved separately.
Context opaque payload is only mutable title/policy/owner/classification/labels/updated_at. Native tenant/key/created_at preservation is tested, not formally encoded.

Row plans, digest/catalog admission, physical identifier derivation and detailed SQL CHECK/FK constraints remain source/caller interpretation obligations; initial schema correspondence includes seeded singleton and active FK.
Concrete AuditAppend appends exact draft+occurred_at content on the supplied connection with no inner commit. Arbitrary TransactionAppend implementations are not all proved lawful.
Actual authentic previous revision document is required for correct semantic change drafts; checking a same-ID arbitrary document is not modeled as authenticity.

Only protocol publishers write tracked pointer/history/objects/context rows. Unrelated/rejection projections are explicitly disjoint; cleanup/history deletion/nonprotocol context writers/Task-route cascades require further composition.
Abort request is separate from server abort/lock release; a returned error can coexist with commit. No native lost-ack or crash experiment was performed.
Aborted publication contributes no successful batch; independent rejection/failure audit and pre-existing identical records remain allowed.

No fairness/eventual availability, coherent successive ordinary SELECTs, sequence rollback, physical crash durability or replica/global adoption claim. Private PG fixture disables fsync/synchronous_commit/full_page_writes.
